maddeler.e:
احتضرتا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَضَرَتَا (iḥtaḍaratā) /iħ.ta.dˤa.ra.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِحْتَضَرَ (iḥtaḍara)
# اُحْتُضِرَتَا (uḥtuḍiratā) /uħ.tu.dˤi.ra.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِحْتَضَرَ (iḥtaḍara) and اُحْتُضِرَ (uḥtuḍira)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
